d: Square in front of the Palace of Bassa on the shore of the sea
Osmin with a ladder, which he leans against a tree in front of the Tür of the palace, climbs up and decreases figs

The Bassa Selim and Konstanze arrive in a pleasure ship, before which another ship with Janitscharen music lands ahead. The Janitscharen set themselves in order on the shore, tune the following choir and then move away.
Garden at the palace of Bassa Selim; on the side of Osmin's apartment.
In front of the palace of Bassa Selim; on one side of the palace of Bassa, opposite the apartment of Osmin, back view of the sea. It is midnight.

Osmin and a black stummer ö open the Tür of Osmin's house, where Pedrillo got into it. Osmin, still half drunk, has a lantern. The mute gives Osmin by signs to understand that it is not right, that he has been walking people, etc.
Pedrillo and Blonde are brought in by another part of the guard.
